subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming remain Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw add a first-party preset/custom theme studio with broader persistence?
rationale: The current implementation already supports external tweakcn import, while the requested native studio and cross-browser persistence are new product surface and storage-policy choices.

options.title: Keep tweakcn import only
options.body: Document that browser-local tweakcn import is the supported customization path and close or narrow native studio requests.

options.title: Add a narrow first-party studio
options.body: Build a scoped picker/editor on the existing CSS-token and customTheme contract, with focused i18n, docs, and UI proof.

options.title: Add synced theme persistence
options.body: Design a server/config-backed preference model before implementation so theme choices can follow users across browsers safely.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow first-party studio
recommendation.body: Build a scoped picker/editor on the existing CSS-token and customTheme contract, with focused i18n, docs, and UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned to the live issue and authored the recent Control UI theming model slices.
